recipe.visualDefinition: A central sepia-toned halftone portrait of three women in a triangular composition, surrounded by a rough-edged, airbrushed rainbow arc that transitions from pink to yellow to green.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast stipple texture against a cream background
Vibrant neon rainbow framing the upper subjects
Bottom-aligned typography overlapping the subject's base
coreInvariants: Heavy halftone/stipple grain texture across all photographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a pyramid; one central and higher, two flanking lower down.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top central face down to the flanking faces, then to the bold text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Cream-colored negative space occupies the lower center and edges outside the rainbow.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon pink, yellow, and green rainbow arc
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border contrasting with low-saturation, high-value sepia tones in the subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure black; use dark brown or charcoal for shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights or sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s aesthetic and tight kerning.
Provides the clean geometric lines and circular counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned halftone portrait of three people in a pyramid layout, surrounded by a grainy, airbrushed rainbow halo on a cream background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add geometric sans-serif uppercase text in the bottom left corner using a solid orange-red color, ensuring tight letter spacing.
